findings: All average30 callback-rate checks passed, but this does not accept camera responsiveness. Cold pan72.52/s has max993.4ms, p95 43.6ms,18 intervals>50ms,4>100ms and2>250ms. Maximum input lateness was1655.4ms.
The993.4ms cold gap begins13.5ms after the window starts; a second320.1ms gap starts1485.6ms into the same window. Warm return89.03/s has max195.1ms.
Cold zoom reaches actual18.500000062092244, averages92.95/s but has636.1ms max,11 intervals>50ms,3>100ms and1>250ms. The largest gap starts12456.3ms into the window, near its end.
Near rotation112.12/s max90.8ms; near pan117.90/s max33.9ms. Wheel back reaches15.703057324223563,112.71/s max33.6ms, with233.8ms final no-render boundary gap reported separately.

Settled pause0 completed render callbacks over2208.2ms. Applied motion lag near0.0338simseconds at playing endpoints, no endpoint underflow; worker source post maximum20.1ms and request roundtrip maximum615.6ms.

Actual body interpolation stayed inside the applied touching0.25s window; signals and traffic probes used the same previous sample timestamp. Paused source28/configured28/displayed27 remains explicitly retained without a clock step.

Settled endpoint canonical exclusivity, source complement, memory guard, shader ready/no failure, actual wheel targets, and no close aggregate passed. No page or console errors. Fresh first-source endpoint still had zero actors and zero geometry before loading.

All six actual PNGs were opened. Foreground buildings remain visibly present; new near people have recognizable bodies and window cards are quieter. Foreground metal roof retains fine parallel stripes, later isolated to its normal response; smooth egg-like crowns and repeated facade cadence remain visual limitations.
